description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the MigrationPreparer plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and includes for dependencies related to migration preparation tasks, along with licensing information.

classes.name: MigrationPreparer
classes.description: A plugin class implementing migration preparation functionalities, integrating plugin interfaces and JSON RPC handling within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information string about the plugin.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints or interfaces.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all RPC endpoints or interfaces.

methods.name: endpoint_write
methods.description: Handles write operations via JSON RPC.

methods.name: endpoint_read
methods.description: Handles read operations via JSON RPC.

methods.name: endpoint_delete
methods.description: Handles delete operations via JSON RPC.

methods.name: endpoint_getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Checks the readiness of components via JSON RPC.

methods.name: endpoint_setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Sets the readiness state of components via JSON RPC.

methods.name: endpoint_reset
methods.description: Resets the migration state via JSON RPC.
